Combines the Bank of Canada legacy series with the Statistics Canada continuation (can-statcan_2026_001).

description: GDP deflator at market prices, base year varies by country, for Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, India, China and Denmark (Denmark added 2026-10-02). Downloaded and processed in the CIMS repository, at data/raw_data/deflator_exchange/ and data/processed_data/deflator_exchange/, by CIMS.data_processing.source.deflator_exchange. The heat database holds only the two processed tables, copied verbatim into data/harmonized/ as reference-currency-deflator.csv and reference-currency-exchange.csv. Refresh by rerunning that script and recopying; do not edit the copies. Held here as reference-currency-deflator.csv (data/harmonized/records/reference): Context/Year/Value, one row per currency-year, 2000-2025 for CAD, USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, INR, CNY and DKK. EUR rows come from the ECB (ecb_2026_001); every other currency from the World Bank. Base years differ between currencies and that is deliberate - the deflator only ever enters as a ratio of two years within one currency.
